description: Get a Stripe-hosted checkout link for a paid plan of N x 200 GB blocks at $5/month per block. This tool charges NOTHING and changes nothing: the human opens the link and pays on Stripe's page, and the quota rises after payment. Call it only when the human has asked for more space, and hand the link back to them; do not open or submit it yourself. If the account already has a paid plan this returns the plan instead (plan size is never changed from here; only the human's click on Obsideo's emailed agree link does that).
name: upgrade
title: Get a checkout link for a paid plan
